name: button
title: Button
description: Triggers an action, with variants for emphasis, three sizes plus icon-only, and a pending state.

examples.title: Contrast
examples.description: The monochrome strong action: near-black in light schemes, near-white in dark, at the lg hero size.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual emphasis. Use one primary per view; danger for destructive actions. contrast is the monochrome strong action (surface.inverse + text.inverse), for when brand colour should stay rare.

props.name: size
props.description: md is the density's control height; sm is 8px shorter, lg 16px taller (the hero size). Height and corner radius match a field (TextField, Select, SearchField, Combobox) of the same size: the corner is radius.field plus half a space step, scaled 0.8 for sm and 1.25 for lg (round brands stay pills). Inline padding is ~1.25 × half the height. icon is a square button of the size's height and requires aria-label.

props.name: isPending
props.description: Shows a spinner, sets aria-busy and aria-disabled, keeps focus and ignores presses. Width stays the same.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Called on mouse, touch, Enter or Space.

props.name: children
props.description: Label, optionally with Tabler icons (mark them aria-hidden).

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the button, e.g. for full width.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the button, including while pending.

notes: Icon-only buttons must have an aria-label; the type requires it for size="icon".
While pending the button stays focusable, is aria-disabled and aria-busy, and screen readers hear the label again when the state changes.
Focus ring: 2px focus.ring outline with a 2px offset, keyboard only.
Every size keeps a target of at least 24×24px, including the link variant.

do: Use one primary button per view for the main action.
Use a verb for the label: "Save changes", not "OK".
Use isPending for async actions instead of disabling the button.
Use variant="contrast" for strong actions when the page's one hero action already carries the brand colour.
dont: Don't use danger for anything that isn't destructive.
Don't use the link variant for navigation; use Link, which renders an anchor.
Don't put a contrast and a primary button side by side: that's two loud actions. Pair either with outline or ghost.
